title: brandkit config
description: Configuration for a brandkit brand guide. It is the single source of truth: it drives the rendered guide and the agent-native exports (brand.json, tokens.json, brand.md).

family.description: Font family name (matches the Google Fonts family).

fallback.description: Optional web-available stand-in for brands whose official typeface isn't on the web. When set, the rendered CSS font stack becomes 'family', 'fallback', sans-serif everywhere the font renders; labels still show 'family' alone.

googleImport.description: Google Fonts css2 query segment, e.g. 'Inter:wght@300;400;700'.

light.description: Hint that the swatch needs a border on light backgrounds.

sourceVar.description: The token this swatch was extracted from. Stable identity for the per-item merge on re-generate, unlike cssVar, which is derived from the name.

authored.description: The colour exactly as written in the source, when it differs from the emitted hex (an oklch value, a keyword, an alpha hex).

logoUsage.description: Logo usage rules. All fields optional. Used for the brand-wide `logoUsage` and, with the same fields, on a single `logos[]` entry to override the brand-wide rule for that logo.

clearSpace.description: Minimum clear space around the logo, expressed relative to the logo itself so it holds at any size. A sentence, or an object with the sentence and a numeric ratio.

oneOf.description: The rule as a sentence, e.g. "the height of the F mark on all sides".

rule.description: The rule as a sentence, e.g. "the height of the F mark on all sides".

ratio.description: The same rule as a multiple of the logo's rendered height, e.g. 0.5 for half the logo height. Lets a tool compute the margin.

minSize.description: Smallest size the logo may be rendered at. Below this it stops being legible.

digitalPx.description: Minimum rendered width on screens, in CSS pixels.

printMm.description: Minimum rendered width in print, in millimeters.

placement.description: Positions on a canvas where the logo is allowed, e.g. ["top left", "bottom left", "centered"]. Anything not listed is not allowed.

dont.description: Misuse rules, one per entry, e.g. "Stretch, squash or rotate the logo". Rendered and exported under a "Never" heading.

basePath.description: Absolute base path the guide is served from (e.g. "/brand"). Empty = served at root / relative. Set this when serving from a non-trailing-slash URL (e.g. a framework rewrite).

name.description: Short brand/slug name; shown as the header wordmark when no headerLogo is set.

version.description: The brand guide's own revision (shown in the banner/footer), not the brandkit package version.

guideLabel.description: Renames the 'Web Style Guide' label in the header and footer.

headerLogo.description: Path to a logo image shown in the header instead of the text wordmark (use a light/reversed logo).

sidebarLogo.description: Path to a logo image shown at the top of the left menu instead of the brand name (use a dark logo).

agentCallout.description: Show the 'Using an AI agent?' callout under the sidebar nav, a copy-paste prompt pointing an agent at the brand.json / tokens.json / brand.md exports. Defaults to true; set false to hide it.

theme.description: CSS custom property map. Keys are token names (e.g. '--accent'). The engine only needs to OVERRIDE the baseline defaults shipped in styles.css.

--accent-foreground.description: Text/icon color ON the accent fill (must meet contrast against --accent).

--accent-text.description: Accent used AS text/links on a light surface (must meet AA).

--primary.description: Primary action fill (primary buttons / CTAs). Defaults to --accent; override to separate the primary action from the accent (e.g. a black CTA with an orange accent).

--primary-foreground.description: Text/icon color ON the primary fill (must meet contrast against --primary). Defaults to --accent-foreground.

--header-bg.description: Header/hero background behind the wordmark or logo. Defaults to --gradient-brand; override (e.g. a flat dark color) for a hero that shouldn't carry the accent.

sections.description: Section intro strings, keyed by section: gradients, logos, logoUsage, formats, components, spacing, variables, gradientTextDemo.

variants.description: Map of format → file path, e.g. { "svg": "logos/mark.svg" }.

formats.description: Output canvases that are not web pages (social cards, slides, video frames, print). Each entry tells an agent how to compose one canvas. Rendered as the Formats section and exported to brand.json and brand.md. A string entry is shorthand for { "preset": "<name>" }.

oneOf.description: A preset name: social-square, social-portrait, social-story, link-card, slide-16x9 (or its dimensions, e.g. "1080x1080").

preset.description: Inherit name, kind, width, height and unit from a built-in canvas: social-square (1080x1080), social-portrait (1080x1350), social-story (1080x1920), link-card (1200x630), slide-16x9 (1920x1080). The dimensions are accepted as aliases. Any field set on this entry overrides the preset.

name.description: Display name, e.g. "Instagram square", "LinkedIn link card", "Slide 16:9".

width.description: Canvas width in `unit`. Required unless a preset supplies it.

height.description: Canvas height in `unit`. Required unless a preset supplies it.

unit.description: Unit for width, height and safeZone. Defaults to "px". Use "mm" or "in" for print.

safeZone.description: Inset margins inside which all text and logos must sit. A number applies to every side.

top.description: Inset from the top edge, in the format's unit. Falls back to `all`, then 0.

right.description: Inset from the right edge, in the format's unit. Falls back to `all`, then 0.

bottom.description: Inset from the bottom edge, in the format's unit. Falls back to `all`, then 0.

left.description: Inset from the left edge, in the format's unit. Falls back to `all`, then 0.

all.description: Inset applied to every side not given individually.

unit.description: Unit for the insets when it differs from the format's unit.

logo.description: Which logo goes on this canvas and where.

variant.description: The `name` of an entry in `logos`. Resolved to its file path in the exports.

placement.description: Where it sits, e.g. "bottom left". Should be one of `logoUsage.placement` when that is set.

maxWidth.description: Largest rendered width on this canvas, in the format's unit.

note.description: Free text guidance, e.g. "omit on slides after the title slide".

typography.description: Which type styles to use on this canvas, keyed by role. `headline` and `body` are the conventional roles; any other role name is allowed.

headline.description: A named style from the `typography` scale, optionally resized for this canvas.

oneOf.description: The style's `name` in the `typography` scale, e.g. "H1".

style.description: The style's `name` in the `typography` scale, e.g. "H1". Weight, tracking, leading and family are resolved from it in the exports.

size.description: Size on this canvas, with unit, e.g. "76px". Overrides the scale's web size, which is usually wrong for a fixed canvas.

note.description: Free text guidance for this role, e.g. "eight words or fewer".

body.description: A named style from the `typography` scale, optionally resized for this canvas.

oneOf.description: The style's `name` in the `typography` scale, e.g. "H1".

style.description: The style's `name` in the `typography` scale, e.g. "H1". Weight, tracking, leading and family are resolved from it in the exports.

size.description: Size on this canvas, with unit, e.g. "76px". Overrides the scale's web size, which is usually wrong for a fixed canvas.

note.description: Free text guidance for this role, e.g. "eight words or fewer".

additionalProperties.description: A named style from the `typography` scale, optionally resized for this canvas.

oneOf.description: The style's `name` in the `typography` scale, e.g. "H1".

style.description: The style's `name` in the `typography` scale, e.g. "H1". Weight, tracking, leading and family are resolved from it in the exports.

size.description: Size on this canvas, with unit, e.g. "76px". Overrides the scale's web size, which is usually wrong for a fixed canvas.

note.description: Free text guidance for this role, e.g. "eight words or fewer".

background.description: The only backgrounds allowed on this canvas.

oneOf.description: A palette color's `name` (resolved to its hex in the exports), the word "gradient" for the brand gradient, or free text such as "photography with a dark overlay".

overlay.description: For photography: the overlay that keeps text legible, e.g. "a 60% Ink overlay".

note.description: Free text guidance for this background.

notes.description: Free text guidance for composing this canvas.

passes.description: Whether this pair clears AA. Failures are kept in the table deliberately: a contrast table that can only show passes cannot report a problem.

textPairing.description: Whether this is a pair someone would actually set as text. Surface-on-surface pairs are excluded from the cautions.

changelog.description: Revision history for the brand guide, newest entry first. Rendered on the standalone changelog.html page and surfaced in the agent exports. Maintain it with `brandkit changelog`. The latest entry's version should match brand.version.

version.description: Revision label, e.g. '0.2'. Starts at 0.1 on a fresh guide; 1.0 = locked/finalized.

changes.description: Bullet list of what changed in this revision.
